lastGoodPrice().notice: Last oracle price successfully validated (USDC per XAUT, usdc-decimal scaled).         Updated on every successful deploy(), recall(), and pokePrice() call.         Used as the conservative floor when the oracle goes stale (PR1).

lastGoodPriceAt().notice: Oracle observation timestamp of the last validated price.

pokePrice().notice: Refresh the cache only from a fresh, complete oracle observation.

protocolName().notice: Human-readable protocol identifier, e.g. "Compound V3" or "Curve 3pool".

recall(uint256).notice: Sell all held XAUT back to USDC and return proceeds to vault.

staleHaircutBps().notice: Haircut applied to lastGoodPrice when oracle is stale (bps, default 500 = 5%).         Board-settable via the standard propose/execute timelock.         Hard cap: MAX_STALE_HAIRCUT_BPS = 2000.

vault().notice: Address of the vault that owns this adapter (receives recalled funds).
